 POSITION OVERVIEW 
 The Assistant Vice-President (AVP), Credit Risk Management, Corporate Financing and Syndication, reviews loan applications and makes informed decisions regarding their approval or recommendation. The incumbent also monitors credit quality and compliance with loan terms and conditions, ensuring that authorizations, disbursements, and loan amendments are aligned with BDC’s risk appetite.
 The AVP will play a key role in assessing and managing the credit risk of this portfolio. In addition to overseeing credit matters, the incumbent will build a close working relationship with the first line of defence and help strengthen its expertise through proactive coaching, clear communication, and the strategic alignment of transactions. The incumbent will also work with partners to effectively assess, monitor, and manage risk while ensuring compliance with BDC’s overall risk appetite.
 CHALLENGES TO BE MET 
 Ensure that loan authorization, disbursements, and amendments comply with established authorization limits and guidelines, as well as BDC’s risk appetite.
 Maintain and enhance the quality of client service by providing prompt, effective, and professional support to front-line staff while safeguarding portfolio integrity through adherence to administrative and due diligence processes.
 Focus on building a close relationship between the first and second lines of defence, with particular emphasis on improving the first line’s risk management practices. Coach, guide, and develop management and staff on all aspects of credit competency, and contribute to their performance assessments by thoughtfully recognizing strengths and areas for improvement and helping identify training and development solutions.
 Contribute to the execution of the business unit’s business plan and profitable growth strategies by ensuring that sound credit due diligence processes are in place and by developing and maintaining strong communication with the unit’s management and staff to closely monitor the key variables required for the successful delivery of financial services.
 Actively participate in business unit meetings and conduct regular visits to support transaction structuring and write-ups, while providing development opportunities for members of the first-line team.
 Proactively identify improvements to lending policies, processes, and products; provide leadership in their implementation; and help staff apply and interpret them, particularly with respect to current credit risk issues and industry direction.
 Maintain and enhance the quality of BDC’s portfolio by approving, recommending, or declining loans, disbursements, and amendments in accordance with established authorization limits and guidelines.
 Lead or participate in various corporate- or regional-level projects to support the continuous improvement of existing procedures and processes while maximizing efficiency in accordance with the risk management framework.
 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR 
 Bachelor’s degree in finance or business administration;
 At least 10 years of experience at BDC or another financial institution in business unit management, business development, or loan underwriting, including at least five years in a Credit Risk Management role, with strong experience in corporate financing, syndication, or complex commercial lending ;
 Experience coaching team members, using demonstrated and effective coaching techniques, and improving risk management practices across the lines of defence;
 Ability to make recommendations and decisions based on key issues, broad business considerations, and context;
 Self-directed, detail-oriented, and skilled at managing priorities;
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both French and English;
 Ability to quickly identify the business context and key issues;
 Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with staff and partners;
 Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to gather information effectively and communicate issues clearly;
 Strong coaching skills;
 Bilingualism required (French and English).

About the Role 
 Feel Your Soul is growing and the team is expanding. We're excited to announce we're hiring — and we're looking for someone like yourself: a technical Klaviyo email designer and copywriter who can build and write converting flows from the ground up.
 Feel Your Soul was started by Jacob Zander out of his own house — no big backing, just a founder who learned shoe manufacturing hands-on in Vietnam and built Footsouls, comfort insoles made for Converse and Vans, from the ground up. Since launching in 2019, the brand has grown around one simple idea: inspiring people to chase their dreams, one step at a time.
 This is not a role where you just execute briefs. You will be the technical builder and creative designer behind Feel Your Soul's email and SMS channel — working alongside our AI tools to write copy that converts, and owning the Klaviyo backend that makes it run.
 What You Will Do 
 - Design and build email, landing page, and SMS flows in Klaviyo
 - Write high-converting copy for email and SMS, using AI tools for drafting while owning strategy, editing, and final polish
 - Set up new automated flows and optimize the ones already running
 - Own performance against KPIs tied to sales conversion within Klaviyo
 What You Bring 
 - Strong technical fluency in Klaviyo — flows, segmentation, automation, optimization
 - Experience with a fashion e-commerce brand or similar niche
 - Both a creative and a technical mind — equally comfortable writing copy and building backend logic
 - Comfortable using AI tools as part of your workflow, with the judgment to refine and QA the output
 Why You Will Love This 
 - Direct ownership of a real revenue channel — your work shows up in the numbers immediately
 - Work directly with the Feel Your Soul team, no layers
 - Part-time to start, with a genuine path to full-time as the role grows
 - $2,000–$4,000/month, tied to sales conversion performance

 The Marketing Associate role at Baxter Canada is a multi faceted, bilingual, communications, digital marketing, and commercial support accelerator position, offering expertise in Digital Health to local marketing teams while helping lead key country communications across internal and external audiences. Digital Marketing involves optimizing commercial strategies, to drive sales growth, marketing efficiency, both internal and external customer engagement, and clear facing communications leadership and support across Canadian business priorities. This includes the use of online platforms, channels, and strategies to promote Baxter’s products and services, reach target audiences, strengthen customer-facing communications, support brand awareness, and enable business growth through service-related initiatives such as renewals management.

 Your Team   
 We develop quality products with the patient in mind, so our marketing efforts are also patient-centric. That means you can be proud of our work and the value we provide to people every day.  
 Develop your skills through collaboration with diverse team members, exposure to various portfolio aspects, and support from encouraging leaders.  
 This is a hybrid position with onsite requirements of 3 days per week.  
 What you'll be doing   
 Provide marketing support for market research initiatives and customer events. Help develop and analyze customer surveys; research competitors, clinical practices, and customer behaviors for team insights.  
 Support and help lead key country communications, including internal updates, external-facing messaging, customer communications, and coordination with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment, accuracy, and timely execution. Collaborate with the Marketing team to lead all aspects of the Education Portal, including refreshing learning materials and maintaining content to keep it current and pertinent.  
 Work with Commercial Perfection and Global Corporate Marketing to get access to, review and present key digital marketing metrics across Canadian assets (i.e. Education Portal, Coordinated Campaigns. Run and refresh Baxter Canada's LinkedIn pages to get along with the professional community and advocate for Baxter's initiatives.  
 Be responsible for the project execution and scaling of customer-facing portals. Provide flexible customer-facing marketing and commercial support where needed, including tasks that may not traditionally sit within digital marketing but directly support customer engagement, service growth, renewals management, and retention priorities.  
 Work closely with different departments on a range of ongoing projects that include third-party vendors, like leading all aspects of the creation and upkeep of micro-sites. Collaborate with Corporate Marketing leads to stay informed about martech (Marketing Technology) platforms being supported at Baxter or equivalent experience.  
 Partner with Marketing leads in the planning and execution of education campaigns and boost initiatives. Partner with Service, Commercial, and Marketing stakeholders to support renewals-related communications, customer follow-up materials, and growth initiatives that help improve customer retention and identify service expansion opportunities.  
 Conduct presentations and training sessions for marketing teams on how to systematically initiate events, webinars, and LinkedIn publications. Provide crucial information and resources to marketing colleagues, including helpful marketing utilities, activities, and tools available at Baxter. Ongoing monitoring and mentorship of campaigns with marketing leaders and corporate marketing.  What you'll bring

 A minimum of 3 years of proven experience in marketing or digital support is needed.  
 Experience with marketing support, customer engagement, communications coordination, research and analysis, innovation in digital marketing strategies , operations support, and commercially oriented initiatives (i.e. contracts management, customer facing engagements, revenue growth initiatives, etc.) 
 Very strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to create clear, audience-appropriate messaging for internal stakeholders, external audiences, and customer-facing needs, with minimal direction.

 Collaboration and organizational skills.

Joignez-vous à l’équipe d’EDC! 
 À Exportation et développement Canada (EDC), nous aidons les entreprises canadiennes à réussir à l’étranger. Nous leur offrons les outils financiers et l’expertise dont elles ont besoin pour explorer de nouveaux marchés et réduire les risques, dans un seul but : bâtir un Canada et un monde meilleurs grâce au commerce.  
 Date limite pour postuler : 28 octobre 2026 à 12 h (HE)
 Poste : Gestionnaire, Recherches sectorielles 
 Type d’emploi : Permanent 
 Détail de la rémunération 
 Facilitation des ventes (stratégie et gouvernement) 19 : Les salaires annuels varient généralement de 112 006 $ à 149 341 $, plus une rémunération au rendement, en fonction des qualifications et de l’expérience. 
 Lieu de travail 
 Exportation et développement Canada évolue dans un environnement de travail hybride, avec une exigence actuelle de présence au bureau trois jours par semaine.
 Ce rôle sera exercé à partir du siège social d’EDC à Ottawa. 
 Une aide à la réinstallation est offerte aux candidats et candidates admissibles. 
 Employés internes : veuillez consulter l’article de ServiceNow intitulé « Mouvements internes – Ce qu’il faut savoir ». 
 À propos d’EDC 
 À Exportation et développement Canada (EDC), nous aidons les entreprises canadiennes à réussir à l’étranger. Société d’État à vocation financière, EDC propose des solutions financières innovantes et des conseils d’experts pour aider les entreprises à explorer de nouveaux marchés, à atténuer leurs risques et à se développer. 
 Pourquoi vous joindre à EDC? 
 Gamme complète d’avantages sociaux : EDC offre un régime de rémunération et d’avantages sociaux concurrentiel, une bonne conciliation travail-vie personnelle et la chance de contribuer à bâtir un Canada et un monde meilleurs grâce au commerce. 
 Conciliation travail-vie personnelle : EDC offre un régime de rémunération concurrentiel et un équilibre travail-vie personnelle. Nous proposons des modalités de travail hybride, de trois à quatre semaines de vacances payées, une période de fermeture collective, des vendredis raccourcis en été. 
 Perfectionnement professionnel : Profitez de nos occasions d’apprentissage continu, notamment des programmes de formation, des ateliers et de la formation linguistique. 
 Culture inclusive : Intégrez un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif qui fait une place de choix à l’équité en matière d’emploi et valorise la diversité des idées, des forces et des origines pour favoriser la réussite. 
 Programmes de bien-être : Nous offrons des initiatives de bien-être, de l’aide à la santé mentale et des programmes de conditionnement physique pour veiller à votre santé et à votre bonheur. 
 Investissement dans la collectivité :  Participez à des activités de bénévolat et donnez au suivant grâce à un éventail de programmes de responsabilité sociale. 
 Aperçu de l’équipe 
 L’Équipe des secteurs et services consultatifs internationaux aide les entreprises canadiennes à se développer à l’international en combinant une expertise sectorielle, des renseignements concrets sur les marchés, des conseils stratégiques et un réseau pouvant déboucher sur des occasions d’affaires à l’échelle mondiale. L’équipe élabore et met en œuvre les stratégies sectorielles prioritaires d’EDC et collabore avec l’ensemble de l’organisation afin de transformer les connaissances relatives aux capacités canadiennes, aux chaînes de valeur mondiales et aux besoins du marché en choix concrets et en occasions pour les exportateurs. 
 À titre de gestionnaire, Recherches sectorielles, la personne choisie dirigera et perfectionnera une équipe chargée de mener des recherches sur les écosystèmes d’affaires canadiens, les secteurs et sous-secteurs industriels, ainsi que les chaînes de valeur mondiales. 
 La personne choisie jouera à la fois le rôle de coéquipier et d’accompagnateur : elle établira les priorités, créera les conditions propices à un rendement d’équipe optimal et continuera de participer activement à des travaux de recherche et d’analyse de grande valeur, ainsi qu’à l’élaboration de conclusions et de recommandations destinées à la direction. 
 Elle fera preuve de discernement, de curiosité et d’un esprit ouvert à l’expérimentation pour aborder des questions de recherche complexes. Elle encadrera des chercheurs, établira des normes de recherche claires et des méthodes de travail réutilisables, et collaborera avec diverses équipes internes. Elle veillera à ce que les chercheurs déterminent les parties prenantes pertinentes pour chaque mandat et sachent déterminer quand il peut être opportun de collaborer ou de confier le dossier à une autre équipe afin d’approfondir la recherche ou d’obtenir un soutien spécialisé. Son travail aidera EDC à déterminer les domaines dans lesquels les capacités canadiennes répondent à la demande internationale et les secteurs dans lesquels EDC peut générer les plus grandes retombées possibles. Cette personne relèvera de la vice-présidente ou du vice-président, Secteurs et Services consultatifs internationaux.
 Ce que vous ferez: 
 Diriger, encadrer et perfectionner une équipe de chercheurs en définissant des objectifs clairs, en répartissant les tâches de manière réfléchie, en fournissant des commentaires en temps opportun, en favorisant la croissance professionnelle et en créant un environnement d’équipe axé sur l’inclusion, la collaboration et la responsabilité. 
 Définir et gérer le programme et le portefeuille de recherche de l’équipe, en trouvant un équilibre entre les priorités stratégiques, les nouveaux besoins opérationnels, les capacités, les échéanciers et la nécessité d’assurer à la fois des résultats rapides et un travail d’analyse approfondi. 
 Continuer d’être un chercheur de terrain en dirigeant des études ciblées et hautement prioritaires portant sur les entreprises, les écosystèmes sectoriels et sous-sectoriels canadiens, les dynamiques concurrentielles, les technologies ainsi que les chaînes de valeur nationales et mondiales. 
 Analyser des enjeux commerciaux et sectoriels complexes, choisir des méthodes qualitatives et quantitatives adaptées à l’objectif fixé, et intégrer la recherche primaire, les sources secondaires, les données au niveau des entreprises et les renseignements financiers et sur le marché.

Job Description Summary 
GE Vernova is looking for a GIS Field Engineer / Supervisor to lead the installation, supervision, testing, and engineering oversight of Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) systems across projects in North America. This is a high-impact, hands-on leadership role that combines field execution excellence with engineering adaptability — built for professionals who thrive on both leading crews and solving complex technical challenges.
If you are a seasoned GIS specialist with strong field leadership, technical drawing expertise, and a zero-compromise approach to safety and quality, this role was designed for you.
If required, the GIS Field Engineer / Supervisor may be called upon to assist the AIS Team 
 Job Description 
 What You'll Own 
 Field Supervision & Site Leadership 
 Lead and supervise GE Vernova field teams and subcontractors across GIS installation, maintenance, repair, and modernization (retrofit) projects —  69 kV to 800 kV 
 Drive efficient execution through hands-on coordination of manpower, tools, equipment, and site resources
 Serve as the  primary GE Vernova representative  and customer interface on site
 Lead daily toolbox talks, safety briefings, and Job Safety Analyses (JSA/AHA)
 Manage site interfaces with clients, contractors, commissioning teams, and project managers
 Monitor installation progress and deliver accurate daily, weekly, and final site reports
 Support commissioning, high-voltage testing, and punch list closure through to formal client handover

 Review converted European-standard mechanical support structure and breaker control drawings into  North American-compliant packages  aligned with IEEE, ANSI, CSA, NEC/NFPA, and local utility requirements – if required amend.

 Write and adapt  Method Statements  for specific job types (new installation, maintenance, repair, Hi-Pot tests) based on existing generic procedures
 Prepare engineering documentation suitable for review and stamping by a licensed Professional Engineer (PE/P.Eng.) where required
 Ensure all engineering changes are documented, traceable, and compliant with client and statutory requirements
 Quality, EHS & Regulatory Compliance

 Manage on-site quality inspections, audits, and hold points
 Verify training, certifications, and PPE compliance for all site personnel

 Champion GE Vernova's  Zero Harm  safety culture at every level of site activity

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!



Role Overview:

Design and implement novel research ideas, ship state of the art models to production, and maintain deep connections to academia and the government. We have one of the highest ratio of compute to engineers in the world. We do not delineate strongly between engineering and research. Everyone will contribute to writing production code and conducting research depending on individual interest and organizational needs. We have all the compute, data, and talent available for you to do your best work.



Key Responsibilities:

 - Design, build and scale agentic AI systems for serving mission critical use cases.

 - Research, implement, and experiment with ideas on our supercompute and data infrastructure.

 - Learn from and work with the best researchers in the field.

 - Execute across the full AI stack and ship products to serve public interest.



Qualifications:

 - Canadian citizenship and eligibility for security clearance (required for this role).

 - Extremely strong software engineering skills.

 - Proficiency in Python and related ML frameworks.

 - Experience training, evaluating, and using (as an end-user) LLMs.

 - Experience using large-scale distributed (GPU) LLM training strategies.

 - Bonus: paper at top-tier venues (such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AIStats, MLSys, JMLR, AAAI, Nature, COLING, ACL, EMNLP).

This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

Where the program sets the standard, your projects and programs bring it to life - on time, on budget, and to spec.

Global Special Projects



 - Project manage Workplace's global special projects: health & safety (H&S) programming, global design standards, global emergency response programming, Workplace Violence Prevention Plans (WVPPs), and sustainability programming across Harvey's office portfolio.

Program Management

ARE YOU A PERSON THAT WANTS TO EMPOWER SMALL BUSINESSES?

Then Jobber might be the place for you! We’re looking for a Account Executive - Inbound to be part of our Sales department.

Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers, while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want! 

Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ahVf4AjYlh4.

The team: 

Our Sales team gains an understanding of who our customers are, what their businesses do, and how Jobber can help them succeed, to turn leads into advocates.

They all have an incredible passion for sales, our customer, and a connection to our purpose. This team is focused on delivering on the promise to make small businesses more successful, and they celebrate, motivate, and challenge each other daily. They are also focused on growth personally and professionally and are supported through regular 1:1’s which focus on performance, coaching, long-term development, and consistent feedback from peers and leaders. 

The role:

Reporting to the Manager, Inbound Sales, the Account Executive will play a significant role in developing relationships and trust with small businesses in our journey to power the world of mobile services. Our sales process while quick is highly consultative, and helping  the customer understand the value and efficiency Jobber could provide their company is paramount.

The Account Executive will: 

 - Drive connection with potential customers through phone, email, and sms outreach.

 - Connect with small businesses to develop an understanding of their challenges and goals.

 - Provide recommendations on how to best utilize Jobber, from specific workflows to feature fits.

 - Demonstrate the value of Jobber through conversation, social proof and product demonstrations

 - Work with the Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) to provide the best customer experience and exposure to the Jobber product.

 - Track key information in Salesforce for follow-up, knowledge sharing, and analytics.

To be successful, you will need:

 - Demonstrated experience in a sales environment with commission and/or targets. You can speak to them, and can speak to how you were successful. 

 - To drive urgency and excitement. You will be required to sell in a dynamic environment with a fairly short sales cycle. You should be energized by high volume and the prospect of uncapped earning potential!

 - To be driven, tenacious and disciplined.. You won’t win over every prospect, and there will be many highs and lows. It’s about how you balance those ups and downs and bring the best of what you have to the job daily.

 - To find solutions. If something isn’t going right, you’ll take care of it. Not every conversation will be the same, and you're quick at thinking on your feet.

 - To be data driven. Being able to source, interpret and create a narrative based on data will be key for your own success as well as the small businesses you’re supporting. 

 - To be coachable and adaptable. The sales team is always changing and evolving, so being flexible and good with change and ambiguity is important.

 - To enjoy technology. We're working hard to empower the world with mobile technology and are looking for someone who wants to share their excitement.

 - To have a clear and confident communication style. You should have the ability to actively listen and consult with our customers and get a true understanding of who they are and what they need. This position involves a good deal of phone time, so these skills are imperative.

 - Previous experience with a Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system, preferably SalesForce.

Compensation:

At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and supportive of your experience and growth. This opportunity has a fixed compensation structure, meaning all employees come in at the exact same rate.  It includes a base salary of $50,000 and a commission of $30,000, for an On-Target Earnings (OTE) of $80,000. Our commission structure is uncapped and paid out monthly, meaning there is potential to earn beyond the stated OTE. 

This OTE is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. As well, this role has clearly defined growth opportunities to deepen expertise, explore new roles, or step into leadership. You’ll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.

If you have any questions about our compensation approach, we encourage open conversations throughout the hiring process!

What you can expect from Jobber:

 - A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options.

 - A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential.

 - A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet.

 - To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers.

We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process.



A bit more about us:

Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!

 We don't want either one. We want the rare person in the middle: someone who serves first, sells because they care, and dials without a second thought.

 That's where you come in.
 The job, in plain English: You'll own a book of existing clients and past prospects. Your job is to call them, serve them, and grow the relationship into new business.
 You'll:
 Pick up the phone. A lot. Your day revolves around real conversations, not emails you hope get answered
 Re-engage clients who haven't heard from us in a while, and past prospects who didn't finish the process
 Run policy reviews, answer questions about policy loans and PUAs, and quarterback service so every client feels looked after. Our ops team handles the paperwork
 Uncover opportunities (new capital, a business sale, a growing family) and ask for the next step. Then book the client with one of our IBC strategists
 Ask every happy client for referrals, and follow up until they turn into conversations
 Introduce clients to our Passive Income Lab when it fits
 Spot clients drifting away and get on the phone before they leave
 Log every call and next step in HubSpot, and own your weekly numbers: contacts, opportunities, referrals, cases

 A servant first. You genuinely want your clients to win, and it shows in how you listen
 Phone-fearless. You'd rather have 50 real conversations than send 500 emails
 Not afraid to ask. You ask for the meeting, the next step and the referral, because you believe in what you're offering
 Relentless on follow-up. Nobody has to remind you, and nothing falls through the cracks
 Motivated by results. You like knowing your numbers and you like beating them

Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked. 
 That is the whole job.
 Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.
 So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.
 At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.
 You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.
 Here is what "end to end" actually means.
 You are the account manager. We do not have any.  You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
 You own the whole funnel, not the campaign.  Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
 You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.  We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.
 You can live anywhere.  We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.
 If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.
 If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.
 What the job looks like 
 Own a set of DTC accounts  as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
 Own the client relationship.  There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
 Audit before you touch anything.  Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
 Run brand and non brand as different businesses.  Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
 Know what PMax is actually doing.  The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
 Keep Google's automation on a leash.  Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
 Own the feed.  Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
 Own the tracking.  GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
 Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it.  Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
 Build the things the account needs.  Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.
 You are a fit if 
 You have done this with real money.  Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
 You are fluent in the whole stack , not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
 You are AI native, and you build.  This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
 You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level.  You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
 You are skeptical of your own numbers.  You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
 You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls.  Where you live is up to you.
 Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.
 You are not a fit if 
 "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
 You want to be told what to do this week.
 You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
 You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.
 Why this role is exciting 
 This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.
 You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.
 You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.
 You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

Provisioning helps organizations of all sizes deploy and manage 1Password through scalable provisioning and organization-management experiences. We build the workflows that help admins onboard people, manage access, and support long-term adoption, with a focus on reliable, secure, and intuitive experiences. As an intern on the team, you’ll work on frontend web experiences in React and TypeScript alongside engineers, product managers, and designers. Our current roadmap includes improving activation, invitation and provisioning-pipeline visibility, error recovery, and other Admin Console workflows.



This is a remote opportunity within Canada/US. This position will be for 4 months - January to April 2027.



What You Can Expect:

 - Confidence: A willingness to take on new challenges, and see them through to completion.

 - Humility: You're not afraid to ask "stupid" questions and make mistakes (as long as you learn from them).

 - Curiosity: You look for better ways of doing things, even if everyone seems happy with how they are.

 - Teamwork: We work together, and succeed as a team!

 - Technical foundations: Working knowledge of React and familiarity with TypeScript and CSS fundamentals.

 - Web development foundations: Comfort with HTML, browser behavior, accessibility, Git, and learning established patterns in an existing codebase.

 - Familiarity with design systems or component libraries, and with Figma or a similar design tool.

Our culture 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. 

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged at 1Password—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events. 


How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.
